_doc: Validate the per-shard checkpoint size-trigger (branch perf/wal-checkpoint-sizetrigger, image :sizetrigger) on the split-lane layout. wal-splitlane measured checkpoint @3s costing 7-11% vs checkpoint-off (ref-3s 286k/272k vs ckpt-off 305k/306k). Hypothesis: --wal-checkpoint-wal-bytes 1GiB (+60s interval fallback) amortizes the checkpoint into a rare event and recovers most of that gap, with bounded replay (<=1GiB retained WAL per shard). Arms share the SAME image; ref-3s is the control at defaults (3s timer). Success = size-1g within ~2% of the 306k ckpt-off ceiling at both stream counts. Requires SPLITLANE=1 SERVER_LOCAL_SSD_BLOCK=1 SPOT_SERVER=1 IMG_SERVER=...:sizetrigger.
